sections.label: Petition terms for Members
sections.summary: The Speaker suggests making the Petition's terms and contents available to Members.

sentences.speaker: The Deputy Leader of the House (Mr Zaqy Mohamad)
sentences.text: While the hon Member has given a brief statement on the material allegations and prayers of the petitioners, I think it would be helpful if the terms and contents of the Petition could be made available to Members.

sections.label: Recording Workers' Party dissent
sections.summary: A Member asks that Workers' Party Members' dissent be recorded and dissenting Members stand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
sentences.text: With regard to the Motion, I would wish that Workers' Party Members have their dissent recorded.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: If I can ask all the Members who are dissenting to stand so that we can record it.
